# A Message to Our Company

NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang sent the following email to NVIDIA employees earlier today.

November 8, 2026

  A Message to Our Company  

I owe my family and all of you an apology.

I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search recent news on the web. Returns titles, URLs, dates and snippets.

message.content:
## Recent developments
* **CEO Transition & Resignation:** Following an independent board investigation launched on November 8, 2026, regarding foreign intelligence targeting and an extramarital affair, founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned effective November 12, 2026 [1, 2, 3]. 
* **Executive Leadership Changes:** Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, has been appointed Interim CEO, and Harvey C. Jones has been named the first-ever Chair of the Board [1].
* **Strategic Partnerships:** On November 8, 2026, NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom announced a collaboration to advance sovereign AI infrastructure utilizing NVIDIA NVLink Fusion [1].

## Talking points
* Express continued confidence in NVIDIA's underlying technology roadmap, hardware ecosystems (such as NVLink Fusion), and long-term enterprise partnerships despite the recent executive leadership transition.
* Acknowledge the leadership stability provided by Interim CEO Colette Kress and the independent board structure.
* Reiterate commitment to ongoing collaborative projects (e.g., sovereign AI infrastructure initiatives with SK Telecom and Rebellions).

## Open questions
* How will the interim leadership transition under Colette Kress impact near-term product release schedules and strategic business execution?
* What additional governance or compliance measures is the Board implementing following the conclusion of the recent independent investigation?
* Are there any shifts expected in NVIDIA's regulatory compliance strategy or international market engagement (such as operations in China) under the new executive structure?

## Sources
* [1] NVIDIA Newsroom - NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
* [2] NVIDIA Newsroom - Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)
* [3] CBS News - Timeline of a scandal: How Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation unfolded at Nvidia (https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jensen-huang-nvidia-resignation-scandal-timeline)
